en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweud, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Baseer, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the teeth and the arms which are both broken deliberately, is there a compensation for these two, or retaliation?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Retaliation’. I said, ‘So if they were to double the wergild?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If they please him with whatever he so desires to, so it is for him’.
